method: Reviewer-authored assessments after reading all eight exact core-field batches and the explicitly recovered truncated passages. The assembly script only attaches these judgments and inventories exact paths; it does not perform semantic review.

family_assessments.R126: The all-state quotient and fiber bounds keep one fixed sufficient state, operation alphabet and output. DVC latches, commit status and event ancestry must be included when material; equality of the presently logged values cannot discharge the quotient premise. Projection transport still supplies no physical selection mechanism.
family_assessments.R127: The task/cut theorems retain the full admitted query domain, common supported side information and joint cut. A retained old token or unlogged timing channel in DVC is not erased by discarding its column. Actual trace/support claims remain conditional on grounded event and boundary facts.
family_assessments.N128: Deterministic joint closure and stochastic joint-law closure remain different. A DVC two-cell snapshot can preserve two particular tokens without proving an entire joint Markov quotient; matching marginal values or laws does not supply the missing dependence premise.
family_assessments.R131: Finite exact expectation probes identify the stated law only under their rank, state and operation contract. DVC's executed reads and source-event identities are different targets; neither a successful fit nor a complete bit response table verifies a complete physical law.
family_assessments.R132: Slot matching, enabled menus and joint next-state/output closure use their explicit finite resource model. DVC gate settings do not identify actual latch contents or complete resource feasibility. Adding reset, commit or capture requirements changes the implementation state rather than refuting these conditional results.
family_assessments.R133: Persistent-model policies and message-cover claims use one fixed hidden mechanism, full observable history, admissible actions and a deadline. DVC keeps the same installation within each episode; its permutations are a finite schedule family, not arbitrary repasting of mechanisms or a measured success probability.
family_assessments.R134: Vector-valued robust policy comparisons, randomized mixtures and opportunity costs retain one fixed task and order of play. DVC event-order counts are not probabilities under a device scheduling law and cannot be substituted into these decision values without another model.
family_assessments.R135: Guarantee regions and approximate simulation require the same tasks, policy class, ports, joint rows and horizon. Nominally matched DVC output is only a selected equality; it neither proves a whole guarantee-region equality nor an actual experiential-type comparison.
family_assessments.R136: Static experiment order, causal-prefix translation and delayed-query access are separate classes. DVC arrival/capture/read deadlines instantiate the same need to honor time-indexed access; a completed record cannot retroactively supply an earlier physical input.
family_assessments.R137: One feasible decoder must work across its full visible fiber with the specified conditional randomness. DVC may not omit persistent latch or random state and then treat matching marginals as fresh conditional samples. Hardware installation remains separate from decoder existence.
family_assessments.R145: Logical interface transport can hide constitutive differences until non-descending physically installed writes are admitted. DVC's proposed branch/capture operations are subject to exactly this port and reset boundary; the older construction is prior coverage, not contradicted by the new apparatus application.
family_assessments.R146: Functional self prediction, external-label identification and independently grounded bearer reference remain distinct. A device command copy or encoder value in DVC does not become a human motor command, proprioception, self-model or familiar self by naming.
family_assessments.TA15: Target typing, fiber factorization and common-intermediate composition retain the same target and actual bindings. Opposed existence models are an external model-class premise, not two allowed UCT interpretations of one admitted complete actual token; DVC asserts no experience-off twin.
family_assessments.TA16: The graph/coding statements have explicitly separate finite premises. RRH remains a historical whole-target conjecture with no established basal gate; DVC validation failure does not activate or prove its proposed existence biconditional.
family_assessments.TA17: Interventional inheritance, quotient access, successor-set beliefs and attribution are separately typed. DVC source occurrence is not inferred from mutual information or shared upstream values, and retained input ancestry does not determine personal identity or familiar feeling.
family_assessments.TA19: Symmetry and covering-space statements preserve the complete supplied structure and fixed labels. DVC external instrumentation can add information or mark a source, but a metadata mark alone does not install a physical relation or select a unique subject.
family_assessments.R149: Complete experiential-type sufficiency requires complete-organization fiber constancy on the same bearer/time domain. DVC selected output, source ancestry and consumer role are narrower descriptors; their dissociation is compatible with the existing projection limit and does not select a named quale.
family_assessments.R155: The finite Bayesian attribution device separates posterior truth, installed consumption and selected mineness. DVC old-token capture failures do not refute its fixed-history likelihood algebra; a copied register does not automatically retain source provenance or establish the independent phenomenal bridge.
family_assessments.R156: The two devices already show that matching a declared snapshot omitting wiring cannot identify an intervention-relative consumer sensitivity. DVC refines an actual acquisition/commit contract and must credit this source as prior coverage; it does not turn potential sensitivity into a record of an executed read.
family_assessments.R157: Internal K-formula transport uses one admitted complete token and transported parameters. It cannot select the external expression familiar mineness, and a missing report is not target absence. DVC C6 preserves these same-instance and semantic-residual limits.
family_assessments.R158: Bearer membership, body binding, efficacy, judgment, report and selected feeling are distinct typed targets. DVC device position and device drive-command ports do not supply anatomical or phenomenal counterparts, and a witness against one conjunction requires an independently warranted target value.
family_assessments.R159: Grounded Anchor/Bind/Use formulas, external referents and anatomical membership are not interchangeable. DVC source tokens and read roles fit the structural side only after admission; coupled role models do not validate a human ownership or agency coordinate.
family_assessments.R160: Protocol-relative effect classes and tokenwise C1 transport retain different scopes. DVC's across-participant psychometric contrasts are statistical summaries, not one within-token K-relation or one shared C1 map across all trials.
family_assessments.R161: The crossed body/tool protocol and its six admissibility gates remain prospective and protocol-specific. The published tactile-attention archive is a different design and does not discharge those gates; an invalid device protocol remains distinct from no experience or no target.
family_assessments.R162: Separate component datasets do not determine an unobserved joint covariance. DVC actually reanalyses one paired dataset but does not supply the exact R161 crossing, an independent pilot, or a prospectively justified interval family. Existing source-scope statements are explicitly finite audits.
family_assessments.R163: The bounded-law and missingness results retain their exact statistical targets. DVC paired-t intervals are model-based conventional inferences, not a universal finite-sample coverage theorem for all bounded laws; no such promotion is licensed by the successful numerical reproduction.
family_assessments.R164: Frozen constant-bet martingale coverage requires the declared target, predictability and boundedness conditions. DVC did not run this interval procedure and supplies no substitute proof from its CSV parse or optimizer convergence.
family_assessments.R165: Pilot-independent coverage, residual-risk transport and menu-relative width feasibility remain different obligations. The retrospective DVC analysis has no claim to be this frozen pilot/confirmatory design or a certificate of hardware or phenomenal feasibility.
family_assessments.R166: The E0-E4 distinction and actual installation witness require grounded same-token Anchor/Bind/Use, local fidelity and bypass discrimination. DVC's digital and empirical components do not promote a population contrast or software trace into an actual neural consumer; the older mediator/bypass witness is direct prior coverage.
family_assessments.R167: Contextual contribution, indispensability, late compensation and actually occurring use have explicit different conditions. DVC gate closure can leave old tokens and late equality can mask an earlier event; these are compatible implementation examples, not a refutation of closure-relative contextual use.
family_assessments.R168: Null-test amplitude, context mass, hidden-fiber regularity and complete route closure remain distinct. DVC's 720 modeled schedules neither estimate a physical context distribution nor certify a physical Lipschitz bound or exhaustive neural route closure.
family_assessments.R170: The admitted target domain and uncovered remainder stay fixed before results. DVC's unmeasured hardware timing and unobserved source paths remain an explicit remainder; finite schedule checks cannot remove it or certify a global amplitude bound.
family_assessments.TE20261008: Retiming transports all relevant delays and histories; selected trace relay subdivision preserves old-endpoint ancestry only. DVC event ticks are not measured physical latency, and its additional captures/snapshots are not automatically full-graph or experiential equivalences.
family_assessments.TO20261008: Production, arrival, comparison-reference use and reported order are distinct events. DVC's schedule/log/physical-onset/intake layers preserve this distinction, and no named temporal or mineness bridge is inferred from a timestamp column.
family_assessments.BR20261008: Realized relation expansion differs from adding an analyst tag, and all anchors must share one common mapping. DVC source headers do not create intrinsic roles; separate matches for two inputs do not establish a jointly grounded actual pair or a named phenomenal correspondence.
family_assessments.R175: The corrected baseline retains only an upper bound of six admissible Boolean valuations and conditional twin/anchor packages. DVC's six valid event schedules are a different denominator and are not evidence of all-six R175 semantic realizability or independent named-content prediction.
family_assessments.R176: Fixed named identities and a genuine production/use timing chain are additional premises. DVC current-consequence feedback chronology is consistent with this earlier order contrast, while source/input time labels alone do not supply an actual experiential order.
family_assessments.IA20261008: Source identity is defined from independently grounded executed trace paths and is invariant only under role-preserving legal retiming. DVC must preserve true source origin rather than trust a new epoch header; its semantic endpoint remains independent of any post-outcome correspondence choice.
family_assessments.R177: Compensated feature preservation assumes stateless executed decoding and fixed source/use binding. DVC has latches and capture windows, so one cannot transport it by invoking the stateless result without verifying the added memory/timing contract; equal data alone still fails to identify an occurrence.
family_assessments.CORE20261008: Minimal supports, intervention order and actual local persistence are target-relative. DVC clears or preserves latches according to declared operations; changing final gate support does not erase the pointed state or earlier route history. Imported gluing cards keep their full-primitive and actual-compatibility guards.
family_assessments.EI20261008: Shared, bypass and redundant task routes already separate intact success from intervention behavior. DVC supplies a concrete acquisition/consumer admission application and does not rebrand these results as new general mathematics or an experience-off experiment.
family_assessments.R183: Constitutive target relevance depends on an admitted actual relation and fixed support/evaluation family. A causally isolated DVC shadow cannot thereby establish a human endpoint intervention or make target success a basal-experience condition.
family_assessments.OO20261008: Parity coding, noise and reverse-query results keep fixed access, source law, readout and deadline contracts. DVC cannot treat a saved payload or device position API as complete source access; its proposed human evidence has no asserted fixed-real-J inequality.
family_assessments.RU20261008: Confidence law, answer target, installed gate use and report are separate. DVC source/epoch correctness is not established by a matching histogram, common reported confidence or an accurate task answer; no phenomenal calibration is added.
family_assessments.R184: A retained target route must span the obstruction and be actually consumed under the declared release policy. DVC's warm-buffer example can contain actual old-token consumption while failing the current-probe target; this does not make all retention illegitimate or identify deliberate versus reflex phenomenology.
family_assessments.RC20261008: One shared retained sample, independently refreshed samples and context-dependent commitments have different joint contracts. DVC atomic pairing identifies intended tokens only with grounded read/episode premises; equal values and single-query laws do not imply physical sharing or neural/phenomenal unity.
family_assessments.IE: The no-empty-switch and task/access examples retain inherited C1/U1 and fixed evaluation timing. DVC does not add separate biological/silicon basal rules. Several explicit quantifier fields are external section locators; those source proofs were not independently reconstructed here.
family_assessments.TH20261009: Stored source recoverability, port recoverability, installed decoder success and actual local persistence are separate. DVC reading a stale token is actual intake of that token but not current-probe intake; extra helper paths or correlated noise cannot be omitted from a complete-cut claim.
family_assessments.RB20261009: The transcript alphabet counts timing, silence, identity and source-relevant helpers before the deadline. DVC source-send logs do not certify arrival or this full transcript cap; helper sharpness still assumes access to both T and X and is not an unconditional physical achievability theorem.
family_assessments.OL20261009: Local-write imitation uses independently installed physical ports, a fixed readout horizon and no unmodeled correction. DVC branch and node operations must be specified at those actual ports/times; virtual coordinate writes or late compensation cannot inherit the old physical certificate.
family_assessments.R185: Occurrence identity requires an occurrence sort, grounded inclusion and actual support, not value or packet-header equality. DVC retained token identity and copied/synchronized routes therefore require exactly the open occurrence evidence already stated here; no shared subject or cross-token numerical experience identity follows.
family_assessments.HOM: Finite-prefix equality holds only from the declared reset and under the named finite actions; a deeper or differently initialized probe changes that class. DVC finite passing schedules do not certify every possible mechanism or all future behavior, and no experience gate is introduced.
family_assessments.UI20261009: Order diagnostics include sufficient state, retained randomness, fixed preparation/readout and the actual action alphabet. DVC latch/commit order is compatible with that requirement; matching immediate values, coordinating copies and hidden order labels do not establish an independent product or a shared carrier.
family_assessments.CM20261009: Correction decomposition, monitor rank and protected-probe moments retain their calibrated same-instance information/timing premises. DVC future shadow ports and logged samples do not establish those premises; quiet late output or a nominal independent probe cannot rule out an unobserved correction path.

targeted_assessments.TA16:RRH_HISTORY: Keep historical-conjecture status. DVC admission eligibility is not Active AND ND AND IRR as a new U1 gate.
targeted_assessments.R155:MEMORY_BOUNDARY: A copied posterior register does not automatically copy a valid history. DVC origin/epoch checking supplies an implementation application, not a new general memory theorem.
targeted_assessments.R156:SNAPSHOT_USE_LIMIT: R(c) is intervention-relative sensitivity; DVC distinguishes it from a particular executed read. The old countermodel is preserved on its stated domain.
targeted_assessments.R160:TOKENWISE_APPLICATION_BOUNDARY: The 18-person reanalysis cannot be transported as one same-token experiential relation. Each physical trial would need its own admitted P/I/K and an additional cross-trial bridge.
targeted_assessments.R162:PUBLIC_COMPONENT_DATA_SCOPE: New tactile-attention data do not refute this old audit of three explicitly named, different data routes or provide its exact crossed protocol.
targeted_assessments.R163:STUDENT_BOUNDED_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Do not describe the DVC paired-t confidence intervals as distribution-free, universally exact finite-sample coverage. Optimizer success and byte-identical reproduction address computation, not this statistical assumption.
targeted_assessments.R166:FINITE_TRACE_INSTALLATION_NONENTAIL: The path/bypass models already agree under natural and upstream probes. DVC is required to ground its actual capture and consuming event, and cannot claim generic bypass nonidentification as new.
targeted_assessments.R167:CONTEXTUAL_USE_CRITERION: Here use is explicitly intervention-closure-relative contribution. Preserve this meaning separately from DVC occurrence-level intake and from universal indispensability.
targeted_assessments.R167:COMPENSATION_TIMING_OBSTRUCTION: A late equal endpoint can follow actual prior use. DVC commit and acquisition timing refine the concrete schedule, not the logical principle.
targeted_assessments.R168:RANDOM_CONTEXT_MASS_BOUND: The 720 schedule count is not an independent physical sampling or detection experiment; it cannot supply n, mu or s_min for this bound.
targeted_assessments.R170:GLOBAL_SUPREMUM_OBSTRUCTION: An unmeasured hardware state remains in the declared unresolved remainder even after every finite reference-model case passes.
targeted_assessments.TE20261008:RELAY_PROVENANCE: Faithful relay insertion preserves the stipulated old-source reachability, not full occurrence count, RetBind or complete type. DVC relay/header changes need the actual path premise.
targeted_assessments.R175:SIX_ROW_EVENT_MODELS: At-most-six valuations remain an upper bound. The six fresh DVC schedules belong to an unrelated 720-permutation family and do not construct these six semantic event models.
targeted_assessments.R175:HELD_OUT_ORDER_PREDICTION: Its effective statement says correspondence completion, with no independently named content prediction. The historical positive-sounding kind label must not override that effective restriction; no DVC-forced theorem rewrite is requested.
targeted_assessments.R176:DELAY_ORDER_CONTRAST: Production and consumer-use order can disagree under the explicit delays. DVC does not supply a perceived-order bridge merely by measuring or simulating such delays.
targeted_assessments.IA20261008:ACTUAL_TRACE_INSTANCE: The actual token must contain the nominated events. A CSV or an external source archive is evidence about a trace, not a constituent inserted into the current process by bookkeeping.
targeted_assessments.R177:JOINT_SOURCE_FEATURE_DOMAIN: A retained, stateful DVC pair is outside the stateless retiming shortcut unless its buffering/window contract is separately transported.
targeted_assessments.CORE20261008:PROTOCOL_ORDER: Equal final support and law can conceal different pointed states. This is direct inheritance for DVC warm latches and reset-versus-gate distinctions.
targeted_assessments.CORE20261008:PRIOR_CG_R: Pairwise source consistency does not assemble one global actual encoder or full primitive structure; DVC two-input agreement does not close that obligation.
targeted_assessments.R183:EXPERIENCE_CHANGE_NO_TARGET_CHANGE: Under an admitted complete comparison, a bypassed relation may change organization while the selected task stays successful. DVC shadow isolation makes no contrary blanket claim of complete experience equality.
targeted_assessments.R184:RTR: Actual post-release consumption is a conjunct. Availability, route membership or a successful external resumption alone cannot establish it.
targeted_assessments.RC20261008:JOINT_GAP: Same single-query law does not identify a common source occurrence. DVC current-pair snapshots are a declared implementation, not proof of a uniquely shared human register.
targeted_assessments.TH20261009:REUSED_MASK: A hidden helper can restore apparent lost source information. A DVC gate flag or payload-only log is not a certified complete information cut.
targeted_assessments.TH20261009:DUPLICATE_CANCEL: Correct duplicated values can cancel in a selected consumer while source storage persists. No null-output-to-no-intake inference is added by DVC.
targeted_assessments.RB20261009:HELPER: Keep the explicit access to T and X; neither a device command copy nor the public human dataset supplies an unrestricted physical helper.
targeted_assessments.RB20261009:TIMING_CONTROL: Arrival time can encode information. DVC must distinguish intended timestamp, software event, physical onset and intake before declaring a complete transcript alphabet.
targeted_assessments.OL20261009:COMPENSATION_CONTROL: The DVC branch test must exclude later compensating writes only if it invokes this fixed-horizon certificate; a general actual consumer may legitimately have them.
targeted_assessments.R185:SAME_OCCURRENCE: Equal source values and equal event tuples do not prove identity or multiplicity. Preserve explicit occurrence IDs and physically grounded inclusion maps.
targeted_assessments.R185:EXPERIENTIAL_COUNTERPART: Each actual token has its own h_i. A shared physical event or synchronized pair does not identify one numerical phenomenal event across tokens.
targeted_assessments.HOM:SHORT_EQ: A finite reference-model pass is not a universal future-mechanism proof; changing the reset or adding state access changes the admitted test family.
targeted_assessments.UI20261009:PRODUCT: Retained latch state, mutable context or retained noise cannot be omitted to force factor independence. DVC makes those event/state distinctions explicit.
targeted_assessments.UI20261009:DELAY_WITNESS: Immediate equal readouts can reveal a retained difference after a common later operation. DVC consumer timing is consistent with this existing witness.
targeted_assessments.CM20261009:PROBE_SETUP: Independence from pre-readout compensator information is an actual timing/access premise; merely labeling a command as a new random probe does not establish it.
targeted_assessments.CM20261009:CAUSAL_MASK: The statement compares late readouts only and retains the initial differing observation. DVC likewise must not call a partial timestamp subset an entire matched trajectory.
